title: feat(hacs): native Home Assistant integration in custom_components/evmqtt
body:
Config flow over the core's device scan, event and switch entities per
input device, hotplug via DeviceWatcher, enable state in the entry
options, EBUSY handling and an optional MQTT mirror with the daemon's
event payload. hacs.json and a local brand icon for HACS.
commits: feat(hacs): native Home Assistant integration in custom_components/evmqtt
author: historical
note: real: key, modifiers and device attributes on the HA event entity written to recorder history; fixed in bb44613
